annotations.text:
Mission Control — the chosen direction (grill session, 2026-08-19).
Full screen set: dashboard, topic page with leveled module cards (basic / intermediate / advanced columns), diagram-first module reader, recall ledger. Progress visuals show illustrative future state; the shipped site renders only what ledger/recall-ledger.json actually contains.
C — Mission Control. Measurement-first dashboard: skill radar (clusters of the 35-skill matrix, evidence from the 2026-08 repo scan), recall heat, topic ladders, module queue.

Directions round (archived) — Option C was chosen.
A and B are kept for reference; their identities stay stable. Do not extend these; all new screens go to the Mission Control page.

A — Skill Constellation. Explore-by-map: topics are stars, progress is light, prerequisites are lines.
Motivation: the whole curriculum visible as one sky.
Tradeoff: map upkeep as modules grow; least conventional navigation.

B — The AI Atlas. Warm editorial expedition: camp → ridge → summit per territory, route map for phases, flags for recall passes.
Motivation: strongest storytelling.
Tradeoff: least dense.
